name: codepilot
description: CodePilot — token-efficient, long-horizon coding agent: core engine, CLI/TUI, web, desktop agent, VSCode & IDEA plugins

scripts.package:vscode: corepack pnpm --filter codepilot-vscode build && corepack pnpm --filter codepilot-vscode package
scripts.package:npm: corepack pnpm -C packages/core pack && corepack pnpm -C packages/protocol pack && corepack pnpm -C apps/tui pack
scripts.package:all: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm package:vscode && corepack pnpm package:npm && corepack pnpm package:idea
